config.independence: same120 parents across conditions; five collection days form one connected day-vessel component; no independent-component confidence interval
config.model_seed_scope: seed17-only robustness for actual-controller compute budget; other studies report three detector seeds
config.noise_definition: CUDA standard Gaussian draw, independently RMS-normalized per clip; same draw shared across SNR conditions and methods
config.score_fitting: reuse frozen natural-real calibration for every corruption, no refit or threshold search
config.selection: hash-sort within UTC day and AIS label; first12 each; interleave background/positive in each day
config.snr_definition: whole recorded waveform RMS to added-noise RMS; not clean vessel-source SNR
config.timing_scope: shared evidence work plus live batched controller/scoring; not an isolated per-method latency benchmark
